content.text: Wambu Anatu suu pyaa nange dupwa Jerusalemena kame kambu doko dee yalo sukusa epa narami dokome
Jerusaleme emba kandokondali pyuo dee porai ingyuo karape.
Wambumi komau keyange wapungi doko suu pyao Anatunya yuu taone poo pyasi doko mondo lao elya pyuo sepe.
Jerusaleme emba karapusi palenge kandapi doko
sinjimu para para pyuo sipinyi doko pyarendanyi nembapala sipurapala kiŋinya petenge isa dokona pisipi.
Yuu Sayone wambu karapusi pyao nyuo peyaminyi
anjisi karaminyi dupwa mokwalapape.

content: Kamongome banya wambu dupwa kando lamaiyuo lao, Kana mendeme nakama ropo pyao nyuo karapusi palyiyaminde daa. Dokona ingyuo nakama nyisa moko eparami lao kana reto nyeraminde daa.

Nakama kata londe wambu ingyuo yuu Isipi dokona pao palyuo kareyami dokopa nakama range panya lao suu piyaminyili pyuo peyami. Dopa piyaminyipape Asiria wambu dupwame nakama suu lao lanyuo papala angi kanape mende reta nayami.

Epapu yuu Bapilone dokona doo piyami dopako pyuo pilyaminyi. Nakama karapusi ingyuo nyuo papala bange mendepe nakama ropo pyao reta nayami. Wambu dupwame nakama iso karapala range mupwa ulipiliŋi lao suu pyao nambana kingi pendewa nembo lao karaminyi.
Yuu gii ene eparamo dokopa namba Anatu dokome nakama langilyamo lao soo nyerami.

content.text: Waili pii minyuo papingi mende yuu kyau dorena piso
waili pii keyange mona kyuu lao seramo doko lao epelyamo doko
wambu raeme kumuo serami.
Baame epo anamasi minyarami lao yuu Sayone wambu dupwa kando lao,
Nakamana Anatu doko kiŋi ingyuo karamo, letamo.
Wambu lapo yuu taone doko iso karaminyi dupwa
ama rae wakasa maiyuo pii poraiyuo letaminyi.
Kamongo kapu kyuo yuu Sayone dokona epelyamo doko
nakamana lenge angi rangena dokome kandelyaminyi.
Kamongo dokome banya wambu dupwa mona minyarambu
banya yuu taone doko kyawa lete nyeramo dokome
Jerusaleme momo nao pasi doko
raeme kumuo pii poraiyuo lape.
Kamongome banya porai renge poo pyasi dokome
banya wambu lete wai pyao nyeramopa
yuu muu peparaeme kandarami ingilyamo.
Nakama tembole anda dokona bange singi nyuo penge dupwa
yuu Bapilone yaki nyuo kandokondali pyuo ipupwape.
Dopa pipala bange koo palenge dupwa minyandasaramano kando lao waso karo
nakama range poo pyasi ingyuo karapala yaki nyuo ipupwape.
Yuu gii dakepa doko nakama wanjamwali lapala
puu pae lao epa nalapape.
Nakamana Kamongo Anatu dokome kata peparaena
embena konambena mendeke ingyuo lanyuo papira ingilyamo.
Nambana kendemande dokome banya yulu dupwa peparae kapa pira.
Baa mee mende ulipili ketae nembaraminyipa karara.
Wambu malumi baa kandeyami dokopa yamarangyuo mona nembeyami.
Banya yongo doko kiki pilya pyana pyuo kombe kwua kwua leyasa wambu lenge kambu nyii naya.
Dopa piyamopape epapu wambu rara malumi baa mupwa lao suu pyao yamarangyuo kandarami dokopa
kiŋi akali dupwame mona nembo pii lalana saka narami ingilyamo.
Dokopa nakama wambape dopale mende kando sepa nange doko
kandapala soo nyerami.
